source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Rear Suspension and Drive Line, p.4-7

procedures.title: Rear wheel bearings: adjust
steps: (continued) Put the bearing spacer and chosen shim on the spindle and set the spindle into the support.

Press the inner bearing race and rollers onto the spindle: place J-4731 over the spindle against the inner race, add a washer and the spindle nut, and tighten until the bearing is far enough on to fit the drive flange (see figure 12 in the manual).
Remove the nut, washer and J-4731; throw the nut away and use a new one for final assembly.
Slide the drive flange on, lined up with the spindle splines; fit washer and nut, torque to specification and fit the cotter pin. If the hole does not line up, tighten to the next flat.
Seat the outer seal of the spindle support in its bore by pressing on the metal part of the seal with a screwdriver or similar tool.
Refit the brake disc and caliper (see Section 5).
Refit the axle drive shaft and the wheel, return the camber cam to its marked position, and torque everything to specification.
notes: Caution: the large end of the spacer faces the outer bearing, and the shim goes between the spacer and the inner bearing.
